pose: 半侧肩回望，一手扶衣领
art_direction: 布玛蓝绿短发与牛仔外套，轻转头微笑，紫环虹膜清晰。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Portray adult Bulma with a short turquoise bob, a plain denim jacket, and an opaque white tee. Turn her shoulders slightly while she looks back toward the viewer, giving a small amused smile. One hand touches the jacket seam below her collarbone, away from her face. Use a pale mint background and simple gouache blocks, with no gadgets or technological interface. Use opaque gouache shapes with soft brush edges, paper texture, and restrained shading. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for recognizable character, readable requested eye motif, appealing expression, original nonviolent composition, coherent anatomy, no text or watermark
